prompt.en: Explain how Jesus comforts His troubled disciples with the promise of the Father's house (John 14:1-3).

prompt.sw: Eleza "Mimi ndimi mzabibu wa kweli, na Baba yangu ndiye mkulima" (Yohana 15:1).

prompt.en: Explain what it means to "abide in Me" (John 15:4).
